who: Adults with stage IIB or III triple-negative or HER2-positive breast cancer who have no symptoms suggesting the cancer has spread to the brain.

biomarkers.name: HER2 or triple-negative
biomarkers.quote: Triple Negative OR HER2+ breast cancer (as per 2018 ASCO/CAP guidelines).

brainMets.quote: Patients with central nervous system symptoms that are concerning for brain metastases that would otherwise be referred for brain imaging.

other.text: Kidney function must be good enough for MRI contrast
other.quote: Creatinine clearance <30 mL/min using the Cockcroft-Gault equation
Pregnant women are not permitted to participate
